verse.verse_1: By the sun and his brightness,
verse.verse_2: And the moon when she followeth him,
verse.verse_3: And the day when it revealeth him,
verse.verse_4: And the night when it enshroudeth him,
verse.verse_5: And the heaven and Him Who built it,
verse.verse_6: And the earth and Him Who spread it,
verse.verse_7: And a soul and Him Who perfected it
verse.verse_8: And inspired it (with conscience of) what is wrong for it and (what is) right for it.
verse.verse_9: He is indeed successful who causeth it to grow,
verse.verse_10: And he is indeed a failure who stunteth it.
verse.verse_11: (The tribe of) Thamud denied (the truth) in their rebellious pride,
verse.verse_12: When the basest of them broke forth
verse.verse_13: And the messenger of Allah said: It is the she-camel of Allah, so let her drink!
verse.verse_14: But they denied him, and they hamstrung her, so Allah doomed them for their sin and rased (their dwellings).
verse.verse_15: He dreadeth not the sequel (of events).
